sclong_1b_mixed_pretraining.availability: official folder redirected then returned HTTP 403 on 2026-08-22
sclong_1b_mixed_pretraining.corpus: 48,024,242 deduplicated human cells and 27,874 genes collected from CELLxGENE, Cell BLAST, and Human Cell Atlas; Methods reports 848 retained datasets while Figure 1 says 1,618 datasets

interpretation: The exact v1.0 source commit is archived, but the selected checkpoint is only a filename inside a mutable SharePoint folder and has no verified bytes, size, hash, upload date, training cutoff, or license. Its four required auxiliary payloads are also unresolved. All Atlas sources, including project-reserved GSE289173, remain exposure-unknown. scLong is blocked from execution, adaptation, conditional-model use, and best openly licensed model status.

preprocessing_and_evaluation_findings.finding: The paper describes raw-count transformation followed by clipping or rescaling each cell to maximum 10, while the released embed script simply requires an already log1p-normalized H5AD. No target outcome may choose between these paths.
Execution depends on an exact 27,874-Ensembl-ID list, Gene2Vec array, GO graph, and pickle hyperparameter object. None has a size, SHA-256, release, or terms receipt.

embed.py emits per-gene 200-dimensional merged_decodings. The paper's described cell representation is a per-gene vector formed by summing embedding and reconstruction features. Neither is an unambiguous scalar cell embedding; pooling must be frozen on development data before cell-state screening.

The source helper zero-fills model genes absent from the assay and mean-fills representations for input genes absent from the model. Structural absence and derivation must remain explicit and cannot silently enter pooling.

The repository environment and README disagree, CUDA 11.8 packages coexist with cuda-version 12.5, embed.py contains an author-local path, and the one-billion-parameter full-length output has no L40S memory receipt.
